answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 30 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The dawn register is checked at draw time, signal lists the eligible set, and pearl seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 30 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. Verification alone takes 2 days each. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
